item.title: Datong, Yilan, Jiuliao River Nature Trail: Walking to Gaba Waterfall
item.description: Today I hiked the Jiuliao River Nature Trail in Datong Township, Yilan, following the Jiuliao River all the way to Gaba Waterfall at the end of the trail. The path hugs the stream nearly the whole way, the water is plentiful and clear to the bottom, and along the way there are suspension bridges, old interpretive signs and a story from the Japanese colonial era. It's a really pleasant waterside trail.
